title: multiplier analysis with ad curve
description:
There is a point where increasing your ad budget starts making you less money. Most brands miss it because they only look at revenue going up and forget to ask the adult question: did profit go up?

In this video, I break down the ad curve, multiplier analysis, marginal return, ROAS, profit analysis, and why scaling paid ads is not as simple as doubling your budget. Your first dollars usually hit the easiest buyers. After that, costs rise, intent weakens, and the campaign starts exposing your math.

Scaling is not about spending more. Scaling is knowing when more spend becomes stupid.
